stem.text: A ball is thrown vertically upwards. Air resistance is negligible.

A.text: By the principle of conservation of energy, the total energy of the ball is constant throughout its motion.

B.text: By the principle of conservation of momentum, the momentum of the ball is constant throughout its motion.

C.text: The kinetic energy of the ball is greatest at the greatest height attained.

D.text: The potential energy of the ball increases at a constant rate during its ascent.
